name: Dice Job Alerts — New Postings from Your Watchlist

parameters.content:
## Dice Job Alerts — new postings from your watchlist
### How it works
Dice is where a large share of US tech jobs are posted first. Every morning this workflow runs each search on your watchlist through the **Dice Jobs Scraper** actor on Apify, compares the results against the Log tab in your Google Sheet, and sends **one Slack alert per genuinely new posting**, each with a one-line AI summary of the role. Postings you have already been alerted about are never sent twice.

### Setup
1. Add your **Apify** credential to the Apify node (the actor is magnova/dice-jobs-monitor — $0.001 per posting returned, no start fee).
2. Create a Google Sheet with two tabs: **Watchlist** (columns: `query`, `location`, `workplaceTypes`) and **Log** (columns: `diceJobId`, `jobTitle`, `company`, `location`, `aiSummary`, `dateLogged`). Point both Sheets nodes at it.
3. Add a **Google Gemini** credential to the chat model node.
4. Point the Slack node at your channel.

### Cost
Each check returns the postings inside your posted window (up to the per-search cap in the settings node), so a daily run costs at most a few cents per search — alerts themselves only fire for postings that are new to the Log.

## ⚠️ Don't delete Log rows
The Log tab is this workflow's memory. Deleting rows makes those postings look new again, and they will re-alert on the next run.

## 1 · Watchlist & settings
The settings node holds the posted window (1, 3 or 7 days), the result cap and the alert cap. The Watchlist tab lists the searches to run — query, optional location, workplace types. The Log tab filters out postings already alerted.

## 2 · Check each search
Searches run one at a time. For each, the actor searches Dice with the row's query, location and workplace types, inside the posted window. Only postings whose job ID is not already in the Log pass, up to the alert cap.

## 3 · Summarize the posting
Each genuinely new posting goes to the LLM, which reads the posting's own text and drafts a one-line summary: what the role is and what stack it centers on. The alert text is assembled from the posting fields plus that summary.

## 4 · Alert, then log
One Slack message per new posting — never a digest. The posting is appended to the Log only after its alert has been sent, so if a run fails mid-way the posting is re-alerted on the next run instead of being lost.

parameters.customBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: $json.query, location: $json.location || undefined, workplaceTypes: $json.workplaceTypes ? String($json.workplaceTypes).split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) : [], postedDate: ({ '1': 'ONE', '3': 'THREE', '7': 'SEVEN' })[String(Number($('Set your watch settings').first().json.posted_window_days) || 7)] || 'SEVEN', maxResults: Number($('Set your watch settings').first().json.max_results_per_search) || 50 }) }}
